title: Long page in a laptop
description: A laptop drawn in CSS (no brand) opens its lid, then your long screenshot scrolls from top to bottom inside the screen with a small gold scroll thumb. On a web page the block stays pinned and your own scroll moves the page in the laptop; a video simply plays. The screen is two thirds of the slide width. On a phone it becomes a tall browser window. For screens, not for portraits.

props.src: required, one tall picture of the whole page (full-page screenshot), or a video (mp4/webm) of the screen
props.caption: one line under the laptop
props.seconds: how long the whole block runs on a slide (default 6)
props.poster: still shown before the video loads

example.caption: A website from the same story.json as the deck.
example.alt: A stand-in for a long web page: a hero, three cards, a line chart and an end card
